## Descriptives
```{r}
data_hcc %>% select(blood_age, status, eth, bmi_cat, alcohol_intake_cat, smokestatus, diabetes, studyarea, sex, year_between,smokestatus_imputed, q1_d_chol, q1_elih_imputed, q1_edih, prs_wt, prs_wt_std) %>%
  tbl_summary(by = status,
              type = all_continuous() ~ "continuous2",
              statistic = list(
                               all_continuous() ~ c("{mean} ({sd})",
                                                    "{median} ({p25}, {p75})"),
                               all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)")) %>%
  add_p(pvalue_fun = ~ style_pvalue(.x, digits = 2)) %>%
  add_overall() %>%
  add_n()
```

## Check for missing PFAS values and rerun descriptive statistics using the complete PFAS data
* Complete PFAS means both control and case (same setnum) have PFAS values
```{r}
data_pfas_missing <- data_hcc %>% filter(is.na(pfas_t_PFDA))
data_hcc_c <- data_hcc %>% filter(!setnum %in% data_pfas_missing$setnum)
table(data_hcc_c$eth)

data_hcc_c %>% select(blood_age, status, eth, bmi_cat, alcohol_intake_cat, smokestatus, diabetes, studyarea, sex, year_between,smokestatus_imputed, q1_d_chol, q1_elih_imputed, q1_edih, prs_wt, prs_wt_std) %>%
  tbl_summary(by = status,
              type = all_continuous() ~ "continuous2",
              statistic = list(
                               all_continuous() ~ c("{mean} ({sd})",
                                                    "{median} ({p25}, {p75})"),
                               all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"),
              digits = list(
                all_continuous() ~ 1, 
                all_categorical() ~ c(1, 1))) %>%
  add_p(pvalue_fun = ~ style_pvalue(.x, digits = 2)) %>%
  add_overall() %>%
  add_n()

rm(data_hcc_c)
```

## Correlation of PFAS(raw)
```{r correlation of PFAS}
sample_id1 <- data %>% filter(status == "HCC") %>% 
  dplyr::select(setnum)

data_hcc_raw <- data %>% filter(setnum %in% sample_id1$setnum) %>%
  mutate(status = ifelse(status == "HCC", 1, 0))%>%
  filter(!setnum %in% data_pfas_missing$setnum)
  
pfas_mat_for_cor <- data_hcc_raw %>% 
  dplyr::select(all_of(pfas_name[-13]))%>%
  as.data.frame()

# Run Correlation Matrix
cor_matrix <- polycor::hetcor(pfas_mat_for_cor)
cor_matrix$spearman <- cor(pfas_mat_for_cor, method = "spearman")

# Get correlation Matrix and  pivot longer
cor_matrix_df_1 <- as_tibble(cor_matrix$spearman) %>% 
  mutate(pfas= names(cor_matrix$correlations[,1])) %>% 
  select(pfas, everything()) 

# Pivot longer
cor_matrix_df_1 <- cor_matrix_df_1 %>% 
  pivot_longer(names_to = "pfas_2",
               values_to = "correlation",
               cols = colnames(cor_matrix_df_1)[-1])

# Get correlation method
cor_method_df_1 <- as_tibble(cor_matrix$type) %>% mutate(across(everything(), 
                                                                              ~str_replace(., "Pearson", "Spearman")))

colnames(cor_method_df_1) <- names(cor_matrix$correlations[,1])

# Pivot longer
cor_method_df_2 <- cor_method_df_1 %>% 
  mutate(pfas = names(cor_matrix$spearman[,1])) %>% 
  select(pfas, everything()) %>% 
  pivot_longer(., 
               names_to = "pfas_2",
               values_to = "method",
               cols = names(cor_matrix$spearman[,1]))

# Combine p values and method
cor_matrix_df_2 <- left_join(cor_matrix_df_1, 
                                   cor_method_df_2)

# Calculate p-values 
cor_matrix_df_2 <- cor_matrix_df_2 %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(p = cor_to_p(cor = correlation, 
                      n = length(unique(data_hcc$sid)), 
                      method = method)$p) %>% 
  as_tibble()


# Relevel factors (This gives a warning because we dont include PFHxA in analysis (100% < LOD)
cor_matrix_df_3 <- cor_matrix_df_2 %>%
  mutate(pfas_names_1 = rename_pfas(pfas), 
         pfas_names_2 = rename_pfas(pfas_2))

## Reorder cor matrix for fig ----------------
cor_matrix_df_4 <- cor_matrix_df_3 %>% 
  # left_join(lod, by = "pfas") %>% 
  arrange(pfas_names_1, pfas_names_2) %>%
  group_by(pfas_names_1) %>% 
  mutate(group_1 = row_number()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(pfas_names_2) %>% 
  mutate(group_2 = row_number()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(correlation_2 = if_else(group_2 <= group_1, 0, correlation),
         p_2 = if_else(group_2 <= group_1, NA_real_, p) %>% 
           p.adjust(., method = "fdr"),
         sig = if_else(p_2 < 0.05, "*", "") %>% 
           if_else(group_2 <= group_1, "", .), 
         correlation_3 = 
           if_else(group_2 <= group_1, 
                   "", 
                   str_c(formatC(correlation, format = "f", digits = 2), 
                         sig)))


## Plot legacy Correlation Plot ----------------
(corplot <- cor_matrix_df_4 %>% ggplot(aes(x = pfas_names_1, 
                             y = pfas_names_2, 
                             fill = correlation_2, 
                             label = correlation_3)) + 
   geom_tile(color = "white") + 
   geom_text() + 
   scale_fill_gradient2(limit = c(-1,1), 
                        low = "blue", 
                        high =  "red", 
                        mid = "white",
                        midpoint = 0, 
                        name= "Spearman\nCorrelation\nCoefficient") + 
   ggthemes::theme_tufte(base_size = 17) +
   theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), 
         axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
         axis.title.y = element_blank()))

# Get info about correlation structure 
cor_matrix_df_4 %>% 
  filter(method != "", 
         correlation_2 != 0) %>% 
  summarise(median_cor = median(correlation_2 ), 
            min_cor = min(correlation_2), 
            max_cor = max(correlation_2), 
            length(correlation_2))


# Save Figure
# ggsave(corplot,
#        filename = fs::path(dir_figures,
#                            "correlation_plot.jpeg"),
#        width = 12,
#        height = 10)

rm(cor_matrix, cor_matrix_df_1, cor_matrix_df_2, cor_matrix_df_3, cor_matrix_df_4,
   cor_method_df_1, cor_method_df_2, data_pfas_missing, pfas_mat_for_cor)
```

## Analysis1. Conditional logistic regression - HCC
**Outcome: HCC vs control**

**Exposure: normalzied log2 PFAS**

**Covars: smoking, diabetes, q1_edih, prs_wt_std, v1:v6**

**Analysis: conditional logistic regression**

**Data Info: 240 cases, 240 controls**

**All races(470), White(47), African American(51), Japanese American(178), Latino(160), Native Hawaiian(34)**

```{r analysis1}
res_hcc <- epiomics::owas_clogit(data_hcc, 
                                 cc_set = "setnum", 
                                 cc_status = "status", 
                                 covars = covars,
                                 omics = c(pfas_name,"pfas_t_PFBS_detected"),
                                 conf_int = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(odds_ratio = exp(estimate),
         exp_ci_low = exp(conf_low),
         exp_ci_high = exp(conf_high),
         type = "Overall")

eth_categories <- unique(data_hcc$eth)

for(race in eth_categories[c(1:2)]) {
  res_hcc_temp <- epiomics::owas_clogit(data_hcc %>% filter(eth == race) , 
                                        cc_set = "setnum", 
                                        cc_status = "status", 
                                        covars = covars,
                                        omics = c(pfas_name,"pfas_t_PFBS_detected"),
                                        conf_int = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(odds_ratio = exp(estimate),
           exp_ci_low = exp(conf_low),
           exp_ci_high = exp(conf_high),
           type = race)
  res_hcc <- res_hcc %>% bind_rows(res_hcc_temp)
}
rm(res_hcc_temp)
# reorder PFAS by estimate
res_hcc1 <- res_hcc |> 
  mutate(pfas_name = str_remove(feature_name, "pfas_t_"),
         sig = case_when((p_value < 0.05 & adjusted_pval < 0.05) ~
                           "FDR p value < 0.05",
                         p_value < 0.05 ~ "p value < 0.05", 
                         p_value >= 0.05 ~ "p value ≥ 0.05"),
         sig = factor(sig, levels = c("p value ≥ 0.05", "p value < 0.05", "FDR p value < 0.05"))) %>%
  mutate(covar = sub(".*~(.*?)\\+pfas.*", "\\1", formula))%>%
  select(covar, everything())
```

## Analysis2. Conditional logistic regression - Categorized PFAS and HCC
**Outcome: HCC vs control**

**Exposure: categorized pfas(quartile)**

**Covars: smoking, diabetes, q1_edih, prs_wt_std, v1:v6**

**Analysis: conditional logistic regression**

**Data Info: 240 cases, 240 controls**

**All races(470), White(47), African American(51), Japanese American(178), Latino(160), Native Hawaiian(34)**

```{r analysis1 cat}

covariate_input <- paste(covars, collapse = " + ")

## create dataframe with names of dependent vars (PFAS) ----
pfas_names <- tibble(exposure = c(pfas_name_cat[-3], "pfas_t_PFBS_detected"))

# Get Model covariates 
covar_names <- tibble(
  covariates =  covariate_input)

# Make all clogit formulas
ind_vars <- expand_grid(pfas_names,  covar_names) |>  
  mutate(formula = paste("status ~ ", 
                         exposure, 
                         "+", covariates, 
                         "+strata(setnum)") |>
           str_replace("\\+  \\+", " + "))

## Analysis for all related participants
ind_vars$clogit_out <- map(
  ind_vars$formula, 
  ~clogit(as.formula(.),
          data = data_hcc,
          method = "efron",
          robust = TRUE
  ) %>%
    tidy(., conf.int = TRUE, level = 0.95) %>% 
    mutate(
      odds_ratio = exp(estimate),
      exp_ci_low = exp(conf.low),
      exp_ci_high = exp(conf.high),
      model_type = "clogit")) 

## Analysis for Japanese American 
ind_vars$clogit_out1 <- map(
  ind_vars$formula, 
  ~clogit(as.formula(.),
          data = data_hcc %>% filter(eth == "Japanese American"),
          method = "efron",
          robust = TRUE
  ) %>%
    tidy(., conf.int = TRUE, level = 0.95) %>% 
    mutate(
      odds_ratio = exp(estimate),
      exp_ci_low = exp(conf.low),
      exp_ci_high = exp(conf.high),
      model_type = "clogit")) 

## Analysis for Latino
ind_vars$clogit_out2 <- map(
  ind_vars$formula, 
  ~clogit(as.formula(.),
          data = data_hcc %>% filter(eth == "Latino"),
          method = "efron",
          robust = TRUE
  ) %>%
    tidy(., conf.int = TRUE, level = 0.95) %>% 
    mutate(
      odds_ratio = exp(estimate),
      exp_ci_low = exp(conf.low),
      exp_ci_high = exp(conf.high),
      model_type = "clogit")) 

## Analysis for Others
ind_vars$clogit_out3 <- map(
  ind_vars$formula, 
  ~clogit(as.formula(.),
          data = data_hcc %>% filter(eth_new == "Others"),
          method = "efron",
          robust = TRUE
  ) %>%
    tidy(., conf.int = TRUE, level = 0.95) %>% 
    mutate(
      odds_ratio = exp(estimate),
      exp_ci_low = exp(conf.low),
      exp_ci_high = exp(conf.high),
      model_type = "clogit"))
# Get final data -------------------

intercept_data<- tibble(exposure = pfas_name_cat, 
                        term = paste0(pfas_name_cat, "1"), 
                        odds_ratio = rep(1,length(pfas_name_cat)),
                        effect_est  = rep("1",length(pfas_name_cat)))

all_results_df_hcc <- ind_vars %>% 
  unnest(clogit_out) %>% 
  select(model_type, covariates, everything()) %>%
  mutate(sig = case_when(p.value < 0.05 ~ "Sig", 
                         p.value >= 0.05 ~ "Not Sig"),
         effect_est = jag2::effest_ci(odds_ratio, exp_ci_low, exp_ci_high)) %>%
  select(-clogit_out1, -clogit_out2) %>%
  filter(grepl("pfas", term)) %>%
  bind_rows(intercept_data) %>% 
  mutate(p_adjusted = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"),
         type = "Overall")

all_results_df_hcc_japan <- ind_vars %>% 
  unnest(clogit_out1) %>% 
  select(model_type, covariates, everything()) %>%
  mutate(sig = case_when(p.value < 0.05 ~ "Sig", 
                         p.value >= 0.05 ~ "Not Sig"),
         effect_est = jag2::effest_ci(odds_ratio, exp_ci_low, exp_ci_high)) %>%
  select(-clogit_out, -clogit_out2) %>%
  filter(grepl("pfas", term))%>%
  bind_rows(intercept_data) %>%
  mutate(p_adjusted = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"),
         type= "Japanese American")

all_results_df_hcc_latino <- ind_vars %>% 
  unnest(clogit_out2) %>% 
  select(model_type, covariates, everything()) %>%
  mutate(sig = case_when(p.value < 0.05 ~ "Sig", 
                         p.value >= 0.05 ~ "Not Sig"),
         effect_est = jag2::effest_ci(odds_ratio, exp_ci_low, exp_ci_high)) %>%
  select(-clogit_out, -clogit_out1) %>%
  filter(grepl("pfas", term))%>%
  bind_rows(intercept_data) %>%
  mutate(p_adjusted = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"),
         type = "Latino")

all_results_df_hcc_others <- ind_vars %>% 
  unnest(clogit_out3) %>% 
  select(model_type, covariates, everything()) %>%
  mutate(sig = case_when(p.value < 0.05 ~ "Sig", 
                         p.value >= 0.05 ~ "Not Sig"),
         effect_est = jag2::effest_ci(odds_ratio, exp_ci_low, exp_ci_high)) %>%
  select(-clogit_out, -clogit_out1) %>%
  filter(grepl("pfas", term))%>%
  bind_rows(intercept_data) %>%
  mutate(p_adjusted = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"),
         type = "Others")


all_result_df <- all_results_df_hcc %>% 
  bind_rows(all_results_df_hcc_japan) %>%
  bind_rows(all_results_df_hcc_latino) %>%
  bind_rows(all_results_df_hcc_others) %>%
  select(exposure, term, odds_ratio, exp_ci_low, exp_ci_high,effect_est,p.value,p_adjusted, type) %>%
  arrange(exposure)

```

```{r Dose response}
data_hcc1 <- data_hcc %>% 
  mutate_at(.vars = pfas_name_cat[-3],
            .funs = ~as.numeric(.))

res_hcc <- epiomics::owas_clogit(data_hcc1 , 
                                 cc_set = "setnum", 
                                 cc_status = "status", 
                                 covars = covars,
                                 omics = c(pfas_name_cat,"pfas_t_PFBS_detected"),
                                 conf_int = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(odds_ratio = exp(estimate),
         exp_ci_low = exp(conf_low),
         exp_ci_high = exp(conf_high),
         type = "Overall")

eth_categories <- unique(data_hcc1$eth_new)

for(race in eth_categories) {
  res_hcc_temp <- epiomics::owas_clogit(data_hcc1 %>% filter(eth_new == race) , 
                                        cc_set = "setnum", 
                                        cc_status = "status", 
                                        covars = covars,
                                        omics = c(pfas_name_cat,"pfas_t_PFBS_detected"),
                                        conf_int = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(odds_ratio = exp(estimate),
           exp_ci_low = exp(conf_low),
           exp_ci_high = exp(conf_high),
           type = race)
  res_hcc <- res_hcc %>% bind_rows(res_hcc_temp)
}

# reorder PFAS by estimate
res_hcc1 <- res_hcc |> 
  mutate(sig = case_when((p_value < 0.05 & adjusted_pval < 0.05) ~
                           "Sig.(FDR < 0.05)",
                         p_value < 0.05 ~ "Sig.(p value < 0.05)", 
                         p_value >= 0.05 ~ "Not Sig.")) 

p_trend_df <- res_hcc1 %>% select(feature_name, p_value, adjusted_pval,type) %>%
  rename(exposure = feature_name,
         p_trend = p_value)

all_result_df1 <- all_result_df %>% 
  tidylog::left_join(p_trend_df, by = c("exposure", "type")) %>%
  mutate(pfas_name = str_remove(exposure, "pfas_lg2_") %>%
           str_remove("_quartile")) %>%
  select(type,pfas_name, term,everything(), -exposure)

## N value for each quartile split by status
# Assuming df is your dataframe

# Convert to long format and create a pair identifier
data_list <- list(data1 = data_hcc %>% mutate(type = "Overall"), 
                  data2 = data_hcc %>% filter(eth == "Japanese American") %>%
                    mutate(type = "Japanese American"), 
                  data3 = data_hcc %>% filter(eth == "Latino") %>%
                    mutate(type = "Latino"),
                  data4 = data_hcc %>% filter(eth_new == "Others") %>%
                    mutate(type = "Others"))

data_n <- data.frame()

for(data in data_list){
  type = unique(data$type)
  long_data_hcc <- data %>%
    select(contains("quartile"), status) %>%
    mutate(status = ifelse(status == 0, "Control", "Case")) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(contains("quartile")), names_to = "variable",
                 values_to = "value") %>%
    drop_na() %>%
    mutate(pair = paste0(variable, value)) %>%
    select(-variable,-value) %>%
    group_by(pair, status) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")
  # Now, to spread back for a wide format summary
  wide_summary_hcc <- pivot_wider(long_data_hcc, names_from = status,
                                  values_from = count, values_fill = list(count = 0))%>%
    mutate(type = type) %>%
    rename(term = pair)
  data_n <- data_n %>% bind_rows(wide_summary_hcc)
}

all_result_df2 <- all_result_df1 %>% 
  tidylog::left_join(data_n, by = c("term","type")) %>%
  select(type:term, Control, Case, everything())%>%
  arrange(pfas_name, type, term)

```

## Meta-analysis
```{r meta analysis}
res_hcc <- epiomics::owas_clogit(data_hcc , 
                                    cc_set = "setnum", 
                                    cc_status = "status", 
                                    covars = covars,
                                    omics = pfas_name[-3],
                                    conf_int = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(odds_ratio = exp(estimate),
         exp_ci_low = exp(conf_low),
         exp_ci_high = exp(conf_high),
         type = "Overall")

eth_categories <- unique(data_hcc$eth)

for(race in eth_categories[1:2]) {
  res_hcc_temp <- epiomics::owas_clogit(data_hcc %>% filter(eth == race) , 
                                    cc_set = "setnum", 
                                    cc_status = "status", 
                                    covars = covars,
                                    omics = pfas_name,
                                    conf_int = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(odds_ratio = exp(estimate),
         exp_ci_low = exp(conf_low),
         exp_ci_high = exp(conf_high),
         type = race)
  res_hcc <- res_hcc %>% bind_rows(res_hcc_temp)
}


# reorder PFAS by estimate
res_hcc1 <- res_hcc |> 
  mutate(pfas_name = str_remove(feature_name, "pfas_lg2_"),
         sig = case_when((p_value < 0.05 & adjusted_pval < 0.05) ~
                           "FDR p value < 0.05",
                          p_value < 0.05 ~ "p value < 0.05", 
                         p_value >= 0.05 ~ "p value ≥ 0.05"),
         sig = factor(sig, levels = c("p value ≥ 0.05", "p value < 0.05", "FDR p value < 0.05"))) %>%
  mutate(covar = sub(".*~(.*?)\\+pfas.*", "\\1", formula))%>%
  select(covar, everything())


meta_df <- res_hcc1 %>% select(pfas_name, type, estimate, se_est)%>%
  mutate(vi = se_est^2) %>%
  select(-se_est)

# write_csv(meta_df, fs::path(dir_result, "meta_df.csv"))

res_df <- data.frame()

# Function to fit model and test heterogeneity for each PFAS
analyze_pfas <- function(pfas, data) {
  # Subset data for the current PFAS
  
  subset_data <- subset(data, pfas_name == pfas)%>%
    select(-pfas_name)
  
  # Fit the random-effects model
  model <- rma(yi = estimate, vi = vi, data = subset_data, method = "REML")
  
  # Calculate and print the I^2 statistic
  # I2 <- model$I2
  # cat("I^2 for", pfas_name, ":", I2, "\n")
  model_summary <- summary(model)
  # Test for heterogeneity
  # heterogeneity_test <- anova(model)
  # cat("Heterogeneity test for", pfas, ":\n")
  # print(heterogeneity_test)
  # Store results in a list
  res_df <- data.frame(
    pfas = pfas,
    tau2 = model_summary$tau2,
    I2 = model_summary$I2,
    H2 = model_summary$H2,
    Q = model_summary$QE,
    Q_df = model_summary$k - 1,
    Q_pval = model_summary$QEp,
    pooled_lg_or = model_summary$b,
    se = model_summary$se,
    pval_model = model_summary$pval,
    pooled_ci.lb = model_summary$ci.lb,
    pooled_ci.ub = model_summary$ci.ub
  )
  return(res_df)
}

# Apply the function to each PFAS
for (pfas in unique(meta_df$pfas_name)) {
  print(pfas)
  temp_df <- analyze_pfas(pfas, meta_df)
  res_df <- res_df %>% bind_rows(temp_df)
}

res_df1 <- res_df %>% 
  mutate(or_ci = paste0(round(exp(pooled_lg_or),2), " [", 
                        round(exp(pooled_ci.lb),2), ", ", 
                        round(exp(pooled_ci.ub),2), "]"))%>%
  rename(pfas_name = pfas) %>%
  mutate(pfas_name = rename_pfas(pfas_name))

writexl::write_xlsx(res_df1, fs::path(dir_result, "heterogeneity_res_1208.xlsx"))
```
